name: PS5X360
summary: Experimental Xbox 360 emulator built on Xenia Canary with RADV Vulkan.
description: An experimental Xbox 360 emulator for PS5 using Xenia Canary, with DualSense input, native audio and RADV Vulkan. Pulls box art from XboxUnity and supports community Canary patches. Booting a menu is not the same as finishing a level — crashes are expected.
author: BrinooTk
warnings: Highly experimental — crashes and visual errors expected.
